groups.title: Instrumental -āz and continuations
groups.proposal: Build the restricted instrumental nounstem family and its licensed huiā or o-ā continuations through typed NNC and denominal-VNC owners.
groups.readingJob: Show nounstem class, connective hu, selected continuation, valence, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Typed Source and licensed continuation are supplied; connective and finite realization are derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not generalize the closed -āz inventory from spelling.

groups.title: Closed compound and control constructions
groups.proposal: Validate the small closed inventory of retained source material, solid-spelling supplements, connective-t structures, matrix-object control, and frozen reflexives.
groups.readingJob: Show exact Source inventory membership, preserved boundaries, controller, and canonical Result.
groups.decisionSplit: A typed licensed construction is supplied; retained material and controller are fixed by its owner.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not make these productive from similar spelling or translation.

groups.title: Exclamations and haste collocations
groups.proposal: Build frozen haste collocations and exclamatory utterances from owner-issued particle Results while preserving their category.
groups.readingJob: Show particle identity, licensed pronoun variant, exclamatory scope, and independent formula and surface.
groups.decisionSplit: Particle and licensed variant are supplied; utterance category and realization are derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not infer a productive phrase from orthographic resemblance.

groups.title: Vocative e
groups.proposal: Apply vocative e only to an exact eligible unit while preserving the unit's internal grammar.
groups.readingJob: Show exact input unit, vocative boundary, category, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: An eligible exact unit is supplied; vocative attachment is owner-licensed.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not authorize vocative status from final spelling alone.

groups.title: The mah particle system
groups.proposal: Keep mah, optional in, and polarity-conditioned principal relations distinct from the ordinary wish particle mā.
groups.readingJob: Show particle identity, optional in, polarity, principal relation, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: The licensed particle relation and optional in are supplied; polarity consequences are derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not merge mah with mā from translation or typography.

groups.title: Frozen ellipsis and such-that principals
groups.proposal: Build quemah ellipsis and cuix, ahzo, ahmo, iuhqui, or iuh principal structures through exact particle or clause Results.
groups.readingJob: Show principal identity, marker clause, supplement, polarity, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Exact principal, marker, and supplement are supplied; relation and ellipsis status are derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not reconstruct a principal from English wording.

groups.title: Roles of incorporated nouns
groups.proposal: Derive adverbial or means-instrument roles from an exact incorporated VNC Result while preserving the personal-pronoun subject and passive-agent barrier.
groups.readingJob: Show voice, incorporated-noun role, subject positions, agent barrier, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Exact incorporated VNC and claimed compatible role are supplied; grammatical role restrictions are derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Never treat the incorporated noun as subject or permit a passive agent mention.

groups.title: Documentary corrections and reanalysis
groups.proposal: Retain textual corrections, vocable boundaries, and sentence-division reanalyses as diagnostic evidence only.
groups.readingJob: Show the documented issue and its analytical significance without issuing grammar.
groups.decisionSplit: No grammatical user choice or production operation is created.
groups.controlPolicy: Never turn documentary examples, corrections, or parser labels into output authority.
